summary: Aurinia Pharmaceuticals Inc. filed an 8-K to report the completion of its acquisition of Kezar Life Sciences Inc. via a two-step tender offer and merger. Aurinia's subsidiary acquired all Kezar shares for $6.955 per share in cash plus one contingent value right (CVR). The tender offer expired on May 8, 2026, with 80.24% of shares tendered, satisfying conditions. The parties are Aurinia as acquirer, Kezar as target, with Fortis Advisors as representative. The merger was consummated on May 11, 2026. Regulatory and shareholder approvals were obtained, and the deal closed within a month. Watch for CVR payments linked to milestones.
